description: This is a Perl script for generating Redboot configurations based on provided kernel and root filesystem files. It includes command-line argument parsing, file size calculations, and script generation logic for firmware flashing.

methods.name: parse_num
methods.description: Parses a numeric string, supporting hexadecimal (starting with 0x) and decimal formats.

methods.name: gen_script
methods.description: Generates a Redboot script based on input files and parameters, writing the commands to an output file.
